pages.title: Connect the endpoints
pages.text: Use Negarite Cable for Negarite and Posirite Cable for Posirite. Run each network from its matching generator to a $(thing)Connector$() touching a machine.$(br2)A plain cable carries power along the route; the connector supplies the machine. Put the two connectors on different faces of the same machine.

pages.title: A first powered machine
pages.text: Try an Auto Constructor with one generator and one matching tank for each flux type.$(br2)Run each colored cable to its matching connector at the crafter. Add blueprints and ingredients, and check the redstone mode.$(br2)When you expand, add tanks or generators if the combined demand exceeds either supply.
